Zero HOT setups. Zero WARM setups. You gotta be kidding me. This is the cleanest read we’ve had in weeks. The market is telling us something. Are we listening? When the squeeze radar goes dark like this, it’s screaming at us to chill out. Imagine a speed limit sign suddenly flashing *STOP*. That’s what this feels like. Risk is neutral. Full stop. 

Let’s zoom out. $SPX is flatlining at resistance, $QQQ looks like it’s running out of gas at that psychological 4,000 level, and even $BTC can’t decide if it wants to flirt with $40k or collapse back into its post-hype nap. We’re in this weird “hurry-up-and-wait” phase. This isn’t a tape you chase. This is a tape you lean back into and let it come to you. We don’t need to swing at every pitch.

Look at the themes from our portfolio. Energy has been a steady hand for weeks now—$OXY grinding higher from our $1.22 entry, $APA holding firm just north of breakeven, and don’t sleep on $UAMY and $MP, both sitting pretty after hitting their 2x profit marks. Rare earths and nuclear have been straight money. $UUUU, $MP, $SMR, $UEC… they’ve all been leadership. That’s where the puck *is*. Rotation back into the materials space is real, and the reality for the bears? They’ve got nothing.

Then there’s crypto. Yeah, it’s a total coin toss on any given day, but let’s not ignore the pockets of strength there. $ETHA and $BLSH are holding full positions after taking profits, and $COIN is still a monster. These aren’t just random moves—this is the market quietly screaming that people want more risk exposure in digital assets. Something is brewing, and every time we’ve seen this setup historically, it hasn’t ended quietly. Keep these on your radar. The cheat code here is knowing when to lean in—and right now, it’s patience.

So, actionable setups today? Not much new. But that doesn’t mean we sit on our hands. Late entries could still make sense on $AFRM as it consolidates strength, and $GRPN is ripping faces off—don’t think that story is over. And $RZLV? It hasn’t been the fastest mover, but it’s a stealth leader in the software space, and we know software has been showing some relative strength against the tape. No dice on double-downs today, but hey, that’s part of the game.

What I want to see today is if energy can show some follow-through. $OXY and $APA are the barometers, but if $BTU catches a bid above $2.50, watch out. The same goes for crypto—can $COIN defend $7? The first two trading hours will be key, so keep an eye there. And for the love of all things holy, don’t force something that isn’t there. This is about playing the long game. Let others get chopped up. We’re here to make money, not feed algos.
